character_select.balance_overlay.description: Draw each selected character's tier after its Character Select player panel and include resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

draw_character_balance_values.description: Replace the first native player-panel draw call with a wrapper that retains it, adds the selected character's tier on its side of the screen, and adds resolved substitution cost when battle character overrides are enabled.

character_select.support_selection.description: Build per-player lists beginning with No Support. All filters through native selection eligibility and retains the native carousel; relevant and none use compact lists and bounded navigation. Share the No Support default, Auto Linked Mode bypass, and special-entry display and name handling.

route_default_support_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's default-support compatibility path while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_initial_support_list_population.description: Route initial Character Select support-list population through the per-player list wrapper.

route_initial_transition_support_compati.description: Apply the selected support mode when Character Select first enters support selection while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_confirmation_support_compa.description: Apply the selected support mode to the primary support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_refreshed_support_list_population.description: Refresh each player's support list through the selected mode's eligibility rules.

route_repeated_confirmation_support_comp.description: Apply the selected support mode to the repeated support-confirmation check while accepting declared special entries globally.

route_primary_fighter_confirmation.description: Select No Support after fighter confirmation, using the native carousel anchor in all mode and compact centering otherwise; finalize immediately when No Support is the only entry.

route_repeated_fighter_confirmation.description: Apply the same No-Support-only direct finalization to the repeated fighter-confirmation path.

route_support_confirmation_without_linke.description: Finalize a selected support in Auto linked mode without opening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_no_support_only_return_to_fighter_.description: Return a finalized No-Support-only fighter directly to fighter selection, or a larger roster directly to support selection in Auto linked mode, without reopening the Linked Mode choice modal.

route_selected_support_display_id.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its name rectangle.

route_selected_support_name_draw.description: Render the table-defined name for an added support and retain the complete native selected-name path for ordinary supports.

route_selected_support_portrait_display_.description: Resolve the selected support through the table-defined display record before Character Select reads its large portrait resource.

route_support_cell_draw.description: Draw only the single non-wrapped occurrence of each entry in a compact support carousel.

route_support_draw_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's draw eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_navigation_left_without_wr.description: Delegate native left navigation except at the first compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place.

route_support_navigation_right_without_w.description: Delegate native right navigation except at the last compact support-list entry, where the cursor remains in place.

route_support_navigation_compatibility.description: Apply the selected support mode to Character Select's navigation eligibility while keeping declared special entries eligible.

route_support_list_available_display_id.description: Resolve an available scrollable-list entry through its table-defined display record.

route_support_list_primary_display_id.description: Resolve the primary scrollable-list entry path through its table-defined display record.
